title: GPU evidence and baseline infrastructure
description:
Create the measurement foundation needed before GPU prototype issues can claim speedups.

## Background

Epic `806eb14e` requires hard performance evidence. GPU tasks must compare against the best existing production CPU path, record hardware and ROCm metadata, and preserve raw benchmark artifacts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Baseline capture covers BCJR, LDPC BP CPU comparator, and BCH syndrome CPU comparator with commit hash, hardware metadata, ROCm version, and benchmark command recorded.
- [hard] GPU benchmark support records batch-size sweeps and phase timing where practical: CPU preparation, host-to-device copy, kernel execution, device-to-host copy, synchronization/waiting, and postprocessing.
- [hard] Speed-threshold checker coverage exists for LDPC >=3x, BCH >=5x, and scheduler throughput improvement, or the issue documents why a checker must remain manual.
- [hard] CPU/GPU equivalence scaffolding exists for small fixtures and production-sized LDPC/BCH fixtures without exceeding fast-tier test limits.

## Notes

Spec doc: `dev/plans/hip_gpu_prototype_wave.md`. This story blocks scheduler, LDPC, and BCH implementation waves.
